_doc: What every gadget shares (Phase 8; game/shared/src/gadgets/DESIGN.md §1-§4). Taking a gadget out of its slot takes `equipS`; a throw winds up for `throw.windupS`, then leaves from `throw.fromM` (right, down and ahead of the eye) at the profile's speed, `upDeg` over the view: Fire throws overhand, ADS lobs underhand, the Nitro Cell has the heavy throw (research/gadgets.md: Y3S4's throw curves, numbers unknown). In flight it is a ball of `radiusM` under gravity (data/movement.json); a bounce keeps `restitution` of the speed into the surface and loses `friction` of the speed along it, and below `restMps` on something flat it comes to rest; after `maxS` anything still flying stops where it is. The owner takes back a gadget that can be picked up by holding Interact for `pickUpS` within `pickUpReachM`. Every number here is ours (placeholders). Metres, seconds, degrees. The level's ingredients (M3, DESIGN.md §9; research/destruction.md §13): a fire extinguisher shot, knifed or in a blast bursts into a smoke `cloud` (5 s, siege.gg) and concusses bodies close by; a gas pipe shot or in a blast throws a flame `jet` along its facing for 15 s (siege.gg: 10 s full, 5 s shrinking; ours keeps it full), burning bodies in it and destroying drones and gadgets it touches, then goes off and leaves a 2 s `fire` (siege.gg's article 2); a metal detector (the Gadget Lab's; Oregon has none) beeps while a body is in its frame, an EMP turns it off, any damage destroys it. Their sizes, radii and damage are ours.
